subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the correct word for the blanks in the given sentence.**

There is a provision of ______ delivery in every courier service whereas a child can ______ his feelings at the age of 2 years or so.
solution: The correct answer is **"express."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Express"** means fast or speedy, which fits the context of the sentence. (तेज़) • The word **"provision"** suggests that there is a specific service offered, and** "express delivery"** is a common one in the courier industry. • The second part of the sentence talks about a child expressing their feelings, which is unrelated to the courier service but still fits with the word **"express" **as it means to convey or communicate something. • The correct answer is Option 4. **Correct sentence**: *There is a provision of **express**__ delivery in every courier service whereas a child can __**express**__ his feelings at the age of 2 years or so. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "normal"**, does not make sense in the context of courier services as it does not indicate any specific type of delivery. (प्रतिनिधिक, सामान्‍य या साधारण, औसत; जिसकी आशा हो, प्रत्‍याशित) • **Option 2, "fast"**, is a possible answer but does not match the exact wording of the sentence. (तेज़, तीव्रगामी) • **Option 3, "slow"**, is the opposite of what is expected in a courier service and therefore does not fit the context. (धीमी गति से चलते, करते या घटित होते हुए, धीमा या धीमे; वेग से नहीं, मंद) 33:T736, The correct answer is** "In low spirits and despair."**
